title: PolicyTest
description: A suite of policy test cases for `halo test`: given an identity, the ring, experiment variants and rendered setting values the policy must produce. Lives under tests/ in the policy repo; the loader does not read it as policy.

cases.description: The cases, each independent. Case names are unique within the suite.

items.description: Resolves identity with the policy's own ring and variant assignment and compares the result with expect.

identity.description: The subject, as the IdP presents it.

os.description: The OS whose rendered files expect.settings reads (default linux).

expect.description: What the identity must get; at least one of ring, variants and settings.

ring.description: The ring the identity lands in. The empty string asserts that no ring matches.

variants.description: Running experiment name -> variant the identity gets. The empty string asserts the identity is not enrolled in it.

settings.description: Harness name -> dotted key path in its rendered config (JSON or TOML; array elements by index, e.g. hooks.PreToolUse.0.matcher) -> the exact value it must have. null asserts the key is absent. Read from the identity's ring release, or from its variant release for a client-axis experiment; unit overlays and toggles are not applied.
